title: Parallax doesn't repeat correctly when scroll scale is negative
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproduced in 4.5 and 4.5.dev

### System information

Windows 11 Home

### Issue description

Contrary to the Parallax2D node's documentation in regards to its scroll scale property, which states:
"Multiplier to the final Parallax2D's offset. Can be used to simulate distance from the camera.

For example, a value of 1 scrolls at the same speed as the camera. A value greater than 1 scrolls faster, making objects appear closer. Less than 1 scrolls slower, making objects appear further, and a value of 0 stops the objects completely."

When follow_viewport is turned off, changing the parallax scroll speed, it is observed that:
- scroll speed = 0 doesn't scroll
- scroll speed > 0 behaves as foreground parallax
- scroll speed < 0 behaves as background parallax
- scroll speed < 0 the repeat wraps textures in the wrong direction

I think that the description needs to be reworded to say "greater than 0 scrolls faster" and "less than 0 scrolls slower", as well as accommodating negative scroll scale in the repeating of textures.

### Steps to reproduce

Add a Parallax2D node to a 2D scene, then add a Sprite2D node as a child of the Parallax2D node.
Set the scroll scale property of the Parallax2D node to a negative number, the repeat size to a positive number, and the follow viewport property to false.
Add some way of moving the camera with user input.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[parallax.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24838118/parallax.zip)
